categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Dinglong Holdings Co., Ltd. primarily operates in semiconductor innovative materials and traditional printing and copying consumables. The semiconductor segment includes CMP process materials, high-end wafer photoresists, semiconductor display materials, and advanced packaging materials. The printing consumables segment covers the full industry chain from raw materials like color polymerized toner to end products such as cartridges and drums.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) materials, high-end KrF/ArF photoresists, flexible OLED display materials including polyimide-based products, and advanced semiconductor packaging materials like semiconductor packaging PI and temporary bonding adhesives. It emphasizes independent R&D, proprietary synthesis of raw materials, and integrated application evaluation systems. Manufacturing includes chemical synthesis, polymerization, and precision material processing with a focus on import substitution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are downstream semiconductor wafer fabs, display panel manufacturers, and printing consumable users. The semiconductor materials serve domestic mainstream wafer fabs and display panel factories, while printing consumables target office equipment users. The company also serves international markets with about 35% of revenue from abroad, focusing on semiconductor and printing consumable sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D bases in Wuhan, Potian, and Xiantao. It also has subsidiaries and operations in overseas markets including Europe and Southeast Asia. Domestic sales account for approximately 65% of revenue, with significant exports and overseas customer engagement.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Dinglong operates primarily upstream and midstream in the semiconductor and printing consumables supply chains. It produces core materials and components such as CMP pads, polishing liquids, photoresists, and toner raw materials, supplying wafer fabs, panel makers, and consumable manufacturers. It also integrates vertically in printing consumables from raw materials to finished cartridges.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in import substitution for critical semiconductor materials, expanding high-end photoresists and advanced packaging materials. It invests heavily in R&D (13.86% of revenue) focusing on next-generation OLED materials, semiconductor packaging PI, and temporary bonding adhesives. The strategy includes synchronized development of materials technology, raw material independence, user validation, talent cultivation, and intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of semiconductor materials, integrated circuit chips, and printing consumables. The company also earns from technology services and licensing. Sales are recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with a focus on expanding product portfolios and market penetration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic platform for critical import substitution materials in semiconductor and printing consumables sectors. It competes with international giants by leveraging proprietary technology and supply chain autonomy. It holds leading market shares in CMP polishing pads and flexible OLED display materials domestically and is expanding in high-end photoresists and advanced packaging materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.34 billion, a 25.14% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 520.7 million, up 134.54%. The semiconductor segment grew 77.4% and accounted for nearly half of total revenue. The company maintains strong cash flow and increased R&D investment, reflecting robust growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hubei Dinglong emphasizes its comprehensive import substitution capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and integrated solutions in semiconductor materials. It offers one-stop CMP material systems, advanced OLED display materials with domestic leadership, and emerging advanced packaging materials. The company’s value lies in supply chain autonomy, high product quality, stable delivery, and close customer collaboration, enabling it to meet strategic national demands and reduce reliance on imports.
